topology_reasoning.device_identification: Symmetric four-port multimode waveguide crossing / compact star junction. Four narrow strip ports enter from west, east, north, and south and flare into broad rounded lobes that overlap at the center.
topology_reasoning.operation: Each strip port expands adiabatically into a wider multimode region at the crossing core. The rounded flare controls modal mismatch and scattering; the centered overlap of the four broad taper ends defines the coupling/crossing region.

image_measurements.central_overlap: black material reaches the full footprint height/width around the centerline because the orthogonal lobes overlap

function_defining_knobs: flare_length: adiabatic expansion length from port to crossing core
lobe_width: maximum width of each rounded taper lobe
center_overlap: amount by which wide taper ends overlap into the central crossing
delta_length: zeroed recreation knob used to prove a path-length/area tunable moves real geometry
topology_reasoning.primitive_strategy: Build four rotated gf.Path straight segments extruded with sinusoidal cross-section transitions. Use primitive rectangles for access extensions if needed and boolean OR only if polygon cleanup becomes necessary. No raw polygons or gdsfactory device stencils.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive model: two orthogonal through paths, each built from six sine-stepped taper/straight sections; stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85 threshold.
